title: Notice of assessment summary
source: synthetic (written for this project; organisations and people are fictional)
notes: Synthetic; imitates the structure of a CRA notice for test purposes only.
summary_en: The CRA assessed the 2025 return: a refund of $412.60 was deposited on August 28, 2026; the letter lists RRSP contribution room and says no action is required unless the person disagrees within 90 days.
text:
Canada Revenue Agency
Notice of assessment
Tax year: 2025
Date issued: August 28, 2026
We assessed your 2025 income tax and benefit return. Your refund of $412.60 was deposited to your bank account on August 28, 2026.
RRSP deduction limit for 2026: $3,150.
If you disagree with this assessment, you can file an objection within 90 days of the date of this notice. Otherwise, no action is required.
